idea-plugin.name: Debug Bridge for AI
idea-plugin.description: Bridges IntelliJ debugger to AI assistants via REST API on localhost:19999. Allows AI to see debug location, inspect variables, view call stack, and control execution. V2 adds multi-project support for debugging multiple microservices simultaneously.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 2.0.0 - Multi-project support: debug multiple microservices simultaneously - New V2 API: /projects, /sessions/{id}, /projects/{id}/* - Stable project IDs (SHA-256 hash of path) - Unique session IDs (UUID) - Backward compatible: V1 API still works 1.0.0 - Initial release with REST API for debug inspection and control.
